eli: Observed a ~12-30ms 99p bump on the FlashAttn-paged path after the 2.3.7 rollout. Low qps repro on local perf harness.

eli: Quick snapshot: hosted-prod, model=xlarge-v2, seq=2048, batch=1 -> p99 jumped from ~45ms to ~65ms. Median unaffected.

raj: :eyes: any kernel fallback spamming in logs?

eli: yes, I see a few lines: `kernel_selector: fallback to fused_flash_v1 (reason=shape-mismatch)` ~3% of requests. Also kv-cache miss rate + prefetch latencies slightly up.

sasha: Reproduced locally with docker image `redwood/runtime:2.3.7`. Running quick tracer shows extra memcpy on the q,k path.

eli: paste of profiling snippet (nvprof-like):
```
flamegraph: main_attn
  memcpy_host_to_device +120ms
  flash_attn_kernel (fused_flash_v1) +40ms
  paged_dispatch +5ms
```

maria: perf-bot ran smoke tests on staging after the roll: `perf-bot: p99 latency delta +18ms (seq=2048,batch=1)`, link: https://perf.internal/runs/1189

raj: Could be the kernel-choice heuristic change in 2.3.7 that prefers fused_flash for odd sequence splits. Any config toggles?

eli: There's a new heuristic param `heuristic.window_shrink_ratio=0.9` that started defaulting in 2.3.7. When I set it back to 1.0 locally the fallback stops and p99 returns to baseline.

kara: Interesting — maybe reduced window causes more prefix re-materialization -> extra memcpy + cache churn. Does kv-cache eviction increase measured bytes?

eli: Yes, eviction counts up ~2.1x when window_shrink_ratio=0.9. Also saw more small batches hitting the prescheduler leading to different kernel selection.

sasha: Quick command I ran: `RUNTIME_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 ./bin/serve --model xlarge-v2 --seq 2048 --batch 1` shows the chooser toggling between paged_flash and fused_flash depending on `max_chunk` rounding.

maria: Recommends: revert heuristic default, run a targeted jobs matrix across seq 512/1024/2048 and batch 1/2/4. I'll queue the matrix in perf infra. :white_check_mark:

eli: I'll prepare a minimal repro and a git range for the change. Steps: 1) pin heuristic to 1.0, 2) run perf matrix, 3) collect nvprof/traces, 4) attempt targeted code revert.

raj: If it's reproducible, please run `git bisect start` on the runtime/chooser commit range and tag suspect commits. Add a `--no-kv-prefetch` toggle to isolate kv impact.

eli: started a local bisect candidate run (small-ish) — early results suggest culprit is the heuristics patch that landed in commit a3f9d2b.

perf-bot: Scheduled perf job #1190: seq=[512,1024,2048], batch=[1,2], kernels=[paged_flash,fused_flash], runs=5 each. ETA ~2h.

kara: Also add a test that logs kernel selection frequency per 10k requests so we can monitor after revert.

maria: I'll add alert rule on staging: p99 delta > 10ms for seq>=1024.

eli: TL;DR: likely regression from heuristic.window_shrink_ratio change causing increased fallbacks to fused kernel + extra memcpy + kv-cache churn. Next: run perf matrix, confirm a3f9d2b is the cause, roll heuristic default while we fix.

raj: Thanks, team. Keep notes in the PR and ping me when you have bisect result. :thumbsup:

eli: will follow up with the bisect range and the minimal repro artifact when ready.
